::: {#sol-six-four-three}

The proposition is false.
Applying @thm-negate-quantifiers to each of its two quantifiers in turn,
its negation is "for all integers $m$ and $n$, $6m + 4n \ne 3$",
and we prove that.
Let $m$ and $n$ be integers.
Then $6m + 4n = 2(3m + 2n)$, and $3m + 2n$ is an integer (@rem-integer-closure),
so $6m + 4n$ is even (@def-even-odd).
But $3 = 2 \cd 1 + 1$ is odd (@def-odd),
and no integer is both even and odd (@rem-integer-closure),
so $6m + 4n \ne 3$.

:::
